definitions.gloss: harvest season; harvest time; harvesting period
definitions.explanation: The time of year when crops are ready to be gathered. Also used figuratively for the period when results of one's efforts become apparent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{稲|いね}→稲：01820_ine⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{収穫期|しゅうかくき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The rice harvest season has arrived.

examples.japanese: {収穫期|しゅうかくき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しく→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Farmers get busy when harvest season comes.

examples.japanese: ぶどう⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{収穫期|しゅうかくき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: The grape harvest season varies by region, but autumn is typical.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧ (harvest) + {期|き} (period). Primarily an agricultural term, but can be used metaphorically for when efforts bear fruit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {収穫期|しゅうかくき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach harvest season
- {収穫期|しゅうかくき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter harvest season
- {収穫期|しゅうかくき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧: farmers during harvest

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧: harvest (the act or result)
- ⟦{植|う}え{付|つ}け→植え付け：21341_uetsuke⟧: planting (the beginning of the agricultural cycle)
- ⟦{作付|さくづ}け→作付け：23457_sakuzuke⟧: cultivation; crop planting
- ⟦{実|みの}り→実り：12270_minori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧: fruitful autumn (poetic expression for harvest season)
